This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

Heard Sri A.M.Biradar, learned counsel appearing for the appellant; Sri G.B.Yadav, Learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for the respondent-State and Sri Sudharshan M., learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.2.
2.

In this appeal, appellant/claimant seeking enhancement of compensation by challenging judgment and award dated 18.04.2015 on the file of IV Additional District and Sessions Judge,
Kalaburagi in LACA No. 655 of 2012.

entities.text:
Additional District and Sessions Judge,
Kalaburagi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel appearing for the parties that, the issue involved in this NC:
2024:KHC-K:1517 appeal is squarely covered by judgment dated 04.06.2018 in MFA No.13424 of 2007.
Accordingly, they sought for similar relief in this appeal.

4. Taking into account the factual aspects on record and recording the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, following the judgment dated 04.06.2018 in MFA No.13424 of 2007, I am of the opinion that, claimant is entitled for compensation of Rs.1,61,120/-
per acre, which has been acquired by the respondent-authorities for the purpose of Lower Mullamari Project.

Accordingly, the Miscellaneous Second Appeal is disposed of in terms of the judgment passed by this Court in the aforementioned appeal and the appellant is entitled for all statutory benefits accordingly.
Sd/-
